name: jmc/header-cta
title: Header Call to Action
description: An optional header button linking to a page, URL or telephone number, or to the business phone, email or WhatsApp.

variations.name: link
variations.title: Header Call to Action
variations.description: Links to a page, URL, telephone number or email address.

variations.name: phone
variations.title: Header Phone Button
variations.description: Calls the business phone number set in Settings → Business.

variations.name: email
variations.title: Header Email Button
variations.description: Emails the business email address set in Settings → Business.

variations.name: whatsapp
variations.title: Header WhatsApp Button
variations.description: Opens a WhatsApp chat with the business WhatsApp number set in Settings → Business.
